query: Who was born first Mahbub ul Haq or Ibn Arabi?

pipeline_result.response: Mahbub ul Haq was born first, as he lived from 24 February 1934 to 16 July 1998, while Ibn Arabi was born on 26 July 1165.
retrieved_context: Mahbub ul Haq: Mahbub ul Haq (Urdu: ‎ ; 24 February 1934 – 16 July 1998) was a Pakistani game theorist, economist and an international development theorist who served as the 13th Finance Minister of Pakistan from 10 April 1985 until 28 January 1988.

Ibn Arabi: Abū ʿAbd Allāh Muḥammad ibn ʿAlī ibn Muḥammad ibnʿArabī al-Ḥātimī aṭ-Ṭāʾī (Arabic: أبو عبد الله محمد بن علي بن محمد بن عربي الحاتمي الطائي‎ ‎ ) ‎(26 July 1165 – 16 November 1240), also known simply as Shaykh Al-Akbar, "the greatest master", was an Arab Andalusian Sunni scholar of Islam, Sufi mystic, poet, and philosopher.  He is renowned by practitioners of Sufism as "the greatest master" and also as a genuine saint.

Ibn Abd al-Hadi: Shams ad-Din Abi Abdillah Muhammad bin Ahmad bin Abd al-Hadi al-Maqdisi al-Hanbali (Arabic: محمد بن عبد الهادي المقدسي‎ ‎ ) better known as Ibn Abd al-Hadi (Damascus, 1305 (AH 705) - 1343 (AH 744)) was a Hanbali Islamic Muhaddith scholar from the Levant.
